```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false


# ---- Packages ----
# install.packages(c("flextable","officer","dplyr"))
pacman::p_load(flextable, dplyr, officer)


# Footnote (legend)
legend_txt <- paste0(
  "Legend — Row color: Direct (blue), Indirect (orange).\nWeight: ",
  "\u25CF\u25CB\u25CB\u25CB\u25CB Low, ",
  "\u25CF\u25CF\u25CF\u25CB\u25CB Medium, ",
  "\u25CF\u25CF\u25CF\u25CF\u25CB High, ",
  "\u25CF\u25CF\u25CF\u25CF\u25CF Very high."
)


# Color code rows by DriverType
col_direct_bg  <- "#EEF2FF"  # blue tint
col_indirect_bg <- "#FFF7ED" # orange tint
col_direct_border  <- "#6366F1"
col_indirect_border <- "#FB923C"

# Borders (left color stripe per row)
b_none <- fp_border(color = "transparent", width = 0)
b_direct <- fp_border(color = col_direct_border, width = 2)
b_indirect <- fp_border(color = col_indirect_border, width = 2)


# ---- Data (from the SVG table) ----
drivers <- tribble(
  ~DriverType, ~Category, ~TerrestrialExamples, ~AquaticExamples, ~Weight,  # Weight: 1..5
  "Direct", "Temperature & heat stress",
  "Heatwave mortality (bats, small mammals); reduced fecundity in carnivores/ungulates; den/roost overheating.",
  "Cetacean thermoregulation stress; pup mortality in pinnipeds; range shifts to cooler waters.",
  4,
  "Direct", "Hydroclimatic extremes (drought/flood)",
  "Vegetation loss → prey decline; collapse of water refuges; increased wildfire exposure; altered migration.",
  "Reduced river discharge (river dolphins/manatees); inundation of haul-outs; flash-flood stranding.",
  5,
  "Direct", "Sea-level rise & cyclonic storms",
  "Coastal refuge loss; saline intrusion into lowland forests; displacement from deltas and estuaries.",
  "Rookery/beach loss; storm-driven pup mortality; haul-out erosion.",
  3,
  "Direct", "Ocean warming & acidification",
  "—",
  "Prey base decline & trophic mismatch; distribution shifts; altered foraging success.",
  4,
  "Direct", "Disease dynamics",
  "Distemper (canids/mustelids), hantavirus in rodents; heat-facilitated parasite burdens.",
  "Morbillivirus & toxoplasmosis in dolphins; harmful algal blooms.",
  3,
  "Indirect", "Habitat loss & fragmentation",
  "Drought/fire → forest conversion; corridor loss for jaguars/tapirs; urban sprawl intensifies heat & barriers.",
  "Mangrove/wetland loss reduces manatee shelter; coastal development blocks haul-outs.",
  5,
  "Indirect", "Prey-web shifts & trophic cascades",
  "Vegetation/productivity changes reduce herbivore prey; cascading effects on carnivores; mesopredator release.",
  "Fish stock collapse → dolphin/seal food scarcity; shifts concentrate whales near shipping lanes.",
  4,
  "Indirect", "Conflict & infrastructure",
  "Drought → new dams/pipelines; roads expand with land-use change; retaliatory killing near farms.",
  "Ports, seawalls, traffic disrupt movement; higher ship-strike & noise exposure as routes intensify.",
  3
)

# ---- Weight rendering (filled/empty circles) ----
weight_symbols <- function(w, maxw = 5) {
  paste0(
    paste(rep("\u25CF", w), collapse = ""),  # filled ●
    paste(rep("\u25CB", maxw - w), collapse = "")  # empty ○
  )
}

drivers <- drivers %>%
  mutate(WeightVis = vapply(Weight, weight_symbols, character(1)))

# ---- Flextable ----
ft <- drivers |> 
  select(c(1:4,6)) |> 
  flextable()
  
ft <- # Column labels
  set_header_labels(ft, 
    DriverType = "Driver type",
    Category = "Category",
    TerrestrialExamples = "Terrestrial mammals – examples",
    AquaticExamples = "Aquatic mammals – examples",
    WeightVis = "Weight") |> 

  # Title row
  add_header_row(
    values = c("Direct vs Indirect Drivers of Mammal Biodiversity Threats under Climate Change"),
    colwidths = ncol_keys(ft)) |>   
  bold(i = 1, bold = TRUE, part = "header") |>  
  align(i = 1, align = "center", part = "header") |> 

  # Styling
  theme_booktabs() |> 
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "body") |> 
  fontsize(size = 11, part = "header")|> 
  align(j = c("DriverType","Category","WeightVis"), align = "left", part = "body") |> 
  valign(valign = "top", part = "body") |> 
  width(j = "DriverType", width = 1.1) |> 
  width(j = "Category", width = 2.2) |> 
  width(j = "TerrestrialExamples", width = 3.6) |> 
  width(j = "AquaticExamples", width = 3.6) |> 
  width(j = "WeightVis", width = 1.1) |> 
  autofit() |> 

  # Apply backgrounds
  bg(i = ~ DriverType == "Direct",
           j = c("DriverType","Category","TerrestrialExamples","AquaticExamples","WeightVis"),
           bg = col_direct_bg) |> 
  bg(i = ~ DriverType == "Indirect",
           j = c("DriverType","Category","TerrestrialExamples","AquaticExamples","WeightVis"),
           bg = col_indirect_bg) |> 


  # Create a thin left border for emphasis
  border(i = ~ DriverType == "Direct", j = 1,
               border.left = b_direct, border.top = b_none, border.bottom = b_none, border.right = b_none) |> 
  border(i = ~ DriverType == "Indirect", j = 1,
               border.left = b_indirect, border.top = b_none, border.bottom = b_none, border.right = b_none) |> 

  # Weight column: make circles darker and monospaced for alignment
  color(j = "WeightVis", color = "#0F172A") |> 
  fontsize(j = "WeightVis", size = 12) |> 
  font(j = "WeightVis", fontname = "Courier New") |>  # good for aligning symbols
  align(j = "WeightVis", align = "center") |> 
  
  # Header colors
  bg(i = 2, bg = "#0F172A", part = "header") |> 
  color(i = 2, color = "white", part = "header") |> 
  
  # Some explanatory lines: legend
  add_footer_lines(values = legend_txt) |> 
  fontsize(part = "footer", size = 9) |> 
  color(part = "footer", color = "#475569")

# Print in viewer
ft

# ---- Export ----
# DOCX
#save_as_docx("Mammal Vulnerability Drivers" = ft, path = "mammal_drivers_flextable.docx")

# HTML (for web embedding or sharing)
#save_as_html(ft, path = "mammal_drivers_flextable.html")

```
